verdict.rationale: The pack includes items sourced from the github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach repository, but none of them states that the source is published or names a license. Those quotes only describe database features (wire protocol, SQL, ACID). Community comments about enterprise-gated features and mandatory license keys concern usage licensing and do not establish an open source license, so no part of this story is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
